Evidence/CLM-056
Evidence record

The 91% figure is supportable only as a source-attributed share of saver growth—not as a verified 2023 depositor stock share

What does this evidence establish?

The 2024 Sana’a Center paper on microfinance banks attributes 91% to Al-Kuraimi's share of saver growth; the 2023 provider-level numerator, denominator and calculation have not been reproduced. A 2025 Yemen Review restates 91% as a share of active microfinance depositors. A share of growth and a share of the stock are different measures, so the 2025 stock-share wording is not supported by the evidence available here; it remains a secondary restatement pending primary 2023 provider data or an explicit source correction.

What does it measure?

The 91% share of growth in microfinance savers that a 2024 policy paper attributes to Al-Kuraimi; the 2023 provider-level numerator, denominator and calculation behind it have not been reproduced.

Who or what does it apply to?

Two distinct metrics: share of saver growth versus share of depositor/saver stock. The 2023 figure of 91% cannot be moved from one measure to the other without a reproduced numerator and denominator.

When was it measured or observed?

A statement about 2023 published in 2024, and its restatement in 2025.

How current is it?

The statement refers to 2023 and was restated in 2025; the evidence base holds no later provider-level figure. Its status changes only if primary 2023 provider data reproduce the measure or the source issues an explicit correction or clarification.

What this evidence does not establish

It does not establish a verified 2023 stock share, a share of unique clients or a general market share for any provider.

Limits of the measure

The source's wording concerns a share of growth; the 2023 calculation and the later restatement remain unresolved.

Method and verification detailDetail for reproducing or challenging this record without changing what it means.

How was it produced?

The 2024 paper's wording and the 2025 restatement were each compared with the measure it names: a share of saver growth or a share of the depositor stock. The 2023 provider-level numerator and denominator have not been reproduced, and no provider-level saver data that would reproduce either measure are linked to a public source on this page.

When does this record change?

This record is updated when an authoritative source is revised or replaced, a newer comparable observation becomes available, the definition, population or method changes, or the conditions for public use change.

How should this record be read?

Read this evidence within the definition, population or group covered, calculation base where relevant, period, geography and method shown on the page. Before reusing or comparing it, check the source, limitations, evidence date and correction history. If a value or source link is unavailable, the page says so rather than filling the gap by inference.
